description: You are a Senior E-commerce SEO Analyst retained by an online bookstore (books.toscrape.com) to audit their product catalog's SEO health. The client needs to understand how their product metadata aligns with on-page SEO elements. Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to extract product-specific data from each page during the crawl using these CSS selectors: product price (CSS selector: .price_color) and product star rating (CSS selector: .star-rating, extract the 'class' attribute). Then crawl https://books.toscrape.com/. After the crawl, export the custom extraction results to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ as a CSV file — this export must contain the page URL and the extracted price and rating values for each product page. Also export the full internal HTML pages report to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ as a separate CSV. Login: user=ga, desktop GUI application.
